info.title: Hacktron REST API
info.description: Public REST API for programmatic access to Hacktron

auth_instructions.description: Target websites and browser login instructions, including URLs and credentials

resolved_at.description: Timestamp of the most recent transition to resolved (ISO 8601). Null if never resolved.

repository.description: Repository URL, or null for findings with no repository

state_reason.description: Reason for the state change (defaults to reason if omitted)

severity_reason.description: Reason for the severity change (defaults to reason if omitted)

reason.description: Shorthand reason applied to both state and severity changes when their specific reason is not provided

duplicate_of.description: UUID of the canonical finding to mark this finding as a duplicate of, or null to unmark. The target must be in the same repository.
UUID of the canonical finding this duplicates, if any.

detail.description: Raw symbol docstring; supplemental context for the stepped taint flow.

code.description: Source code lines for this step's symbol, pre-sliced by the worker.

code_start_line.description: 1-based start line number of the `code` slice in the source file. Used by the frontend as the anchor for chevron-expand requests to GET /findings/:uuid/source.

code_end_line.description: 1-based end line number of the `code` slice in the source file. Used by the frontend as the anchor for chevron-expand requests to GET /findings/:uuid/source.

resolved_at.description: Timestamp of the most recent transition to resolved (ISO 8601). Null if never resolved.

github_installation_id.description: GitHub App installation ID. Omitted for PAT-based connections (e.g. GitHub Enterprise), where the installation is resolved from repo_url and the organization instead.

from_cache.description: Whether result was served from cache

unsupported_languages.description: Detected unsupported languages among the top languages

scoped_file_count.description: Files that matched the repository's whitebox scope rules, counted on disk before analysis. Absent for unscoped repositories.

total_credits.description: Total estimated credits across all repos

triage_required.description: Whether human triage is mandatory for a scan of this estimation (large app, above the predicted-cost threshold). The customer cannot opt out when true.

triage_fee_credits.description: Triage fee in credits (a percentage of the scan base credits) added when triage is enabled

updated_at.description: Timestamp when estimation was last updated

name.description: Display name (owner/repo for GitHub, namespace/project for GitLab, workspace/slug for Bitbucket, project/repository for Azure DevOps)

providerKey.description: Provider-native identifier for mutation endpoints. GitHub: owner/repo, GitLab: numeric projectId (as string), Bitbucket: repository UUID, Azure DevOps: repository UUID.

enabled.description: Whether the repository is enabled for scanning

threatModelUpdatedAt.description: ISO timestamp of the repo's most recent threat_model.md update, or null if it has none. Repos are returned ordered by this (most recent first; repos without a threat model last).

openFindingsCount.description: Number of approved, visible findings that remain open for this repository

lastScanAt.description: ISO timestamp of the most recent completed scan containing this repository, or null if it has not been scanned

ossApproved.description: Whether this github.com repository is approved for free OSS PR reviews. Independent of whether PR scans are enabled.

prScansEnabled.description: Whether PR/MR scans are enabled (GitHub and GitLab)

prScanBranches.description: Target branch patterns for PR/MR scans (GitHub and GitLab)

baseUrl.description: GitHub Enterprise base URL for self-hosted (PAT) installations (null/absent for github.com), the GitLab installation URL, or the Azure DevOps organization URL. Clients should build clone/display URLs from this host instead of assuming the public provider host.

webhookRegistered.description: Whether a webhook is registered for this project (GitLab only)

isPrivate.description: Whether the repository is private (Bitbucket only)

repos.description: Unified list of repositories from all providers

include_paths.description: Whitebox scope: gitignore-style globs (relative to the repo root) that narrow the scan to matching paths. Empty means the whole repository.

exclude_paths.description: Whitebox scope: gitignore-style globs removed from the scan after include_paths is applied; use `*.md` to drop a file type.

branch.description: Branch name, tag name, or commit SHA

ref_type.description: How `branch` was selected (UI hint for draft re-use)

github_installation_id.description: GitHub App installation id. Omitted for PAT-based connections (e.g. GitHub Enterprise), where the installation is resolved from the repository URL and the organization instead.

include_paths.description: Whitebox scope: gitignore-style globs (relative to the repo root) that narrow the scan to matching paths. Empty means the whole repository.

exclude_paths.description: Whitebox scope: gitignore-style globs removed from the scan after include_paths is applied; use `*.md` to drop a file type.

branch.description: Branch name, tag name, or commit SHA

ref_type.description: How `branch` was selected (UI hint for draft re-use)

include_paths.description: Whitebox scope: gitignore-style globs (relative to the repo root) that narrow the scan to matching paths. Empty means the whole repository.

exclude_paths.description: Whitebox scope: gitignore-style globs removed from the scan after include_paths is applied; use `*.md` to drop a file type.

site.description: A deployed copy of the app to test signed in, e.g. https://staging.acme.dev

login_instructions.description: How to sign in: the login page, username, password and any steps. Stored encrypted and never returned.

application_id.description: iva application this scan targets (group of repos)

login_targets.description: Deployed sites to test signed in, each with how to sign in. On update the list replaces the saved one, and [] removes them. A pentest tests live sites either all signed in or all without a login (target_urls). Check each login with POST /pentests/{id}/login-checks before starting.

repos.description: Repositories or uploaded archives to test

include_paths.description: Whitebox scope: gitignore-style globs (relative to the repo root) that narrow the scan to matching paths. Empty means the whole repository.

exclude_paths.description: Whitebox scope: gitignore-style globs removed from the scan after include_paths is applied; use `*.md` to drop a file type.

provider.description: Resolved by the server at scan start; ignored on input

branch.description: Branch name, tag name, or commit SHA

ref_type.description: How `branch` was selected (UI hint for draft re-use)

github_installation_id.description: GitHub App installation ID (connected repos only)

login_check.description: Whether Hacktron could sign in with the login the site has now. A pass lasts an hour, and changing the site or login makes it unverified.

failure_reason.description: Why the check failed, without credentials

scan_id.description: Stable pentest id; task_id changes when it starts

application_id.description: iva application this scan targets (group of repos)

login_targets.description: Deployed sites to test signed in, each with how to sign in. On update the list replaces the saved one, and [] removes them. A pentest tests live sites either all signed in or all without a login (target_urls). Check each login with POST /pentests/{id}/login-checks before starting.

repos.description: Repositories or uploaded archives to test, replacing the saved ones. Changing them clears the estimate, so estimate again before starting.

expected_credits.description: The total the user confirmed: the estimate's total_credits, plus triage_fee_credits when triage is required or opted in

triage_enabled.description: Opt in to human triage of findings when it is not already required

content_type.description: Content-Type to use in the PUT request

balance.description: Current pentest credit balance available for use

total_purchased.description: Total pentest credits purchased across all time

total_used.description: Total pentest credits deducted for completed/running pentests

total_refunded.description: Total pentest credits refunded from cancelled pentests

total_granted.description: Total pentest credits granted at no charge

used_this_period.description: Credits deducted since the start of the current billing period, null when the organization has no billing period

is_unlimited.description: Whether this organization has internal unlimited pentest entitlement
